title: Voice remote: talk to a mastermind from your phone, fast

chat.text: A Bluetooth headset, the phone in your pocket, and the Claude app's voice agent passing your questions to a mastermind and hearing answers back in seconds. First a voice-agents guide, then real latency numbers, then a faster bridge built in a worktree.

message.text: The voice-agents guide is live: /framework/ai/doc/voice-agents.md. The bridge is built on a branch: the mastermind now speaks one sentence first (about 9 s instead of 40 s), and the phone hears it by itself on its next tool call. It's in review now. Today's real blocker is low memory, which keeps any new voice mastermind from starting.
